key_insight: AMM routes a fixed evaluation budget among classical optimizers using online landscape probes rather than relying on a single optimizer.
engineering_relevance: For continuous black-box engineering optimization, AMM offers an open-source Python approach that adapts solver choice while charging probe costs to the available budget.
method: Probe curvature, plateaus, separability, kinks, basins and fractal structure online.
Route evaluations among quasi-Newton, trust-region, coordinate, multistart and evolution-strategy engines.
Give each probe a default and a dimension–budget validity range.
evidence_signal: On held-out bbob instances 101–110, spanning dimensions 2–40 and budgets 10D–1000D, AMM achieved the highest target share in 382 of 600 cells: 236 outright and 146 tied.
watch_item: Performance is not uniformly superior: low-budget deficits remain, rotation removes most gains on separable f3–f4, and held-out MA-BBOB shows final-share parity with IPOP-CMA-ES but lower anytime area.
paper_title: Adaptive Multi Mode: Budget-Aware Routing of Optimizers By Online Landscape Probes
